items.title: Gorenstein morphisms of algebraic spaces tested on etale charts and at points via strict local rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The algebraic-spaces criterion for the Gorenstein property, structured exactly as the Cohen-Macaulay criterion: three chartwise conditions using surjective etale charts by schemes, plus a pointwise equivalence comparing the strict local rings of a point and its image. The proof establishes the equivalence of the chartwise conditions by etale descent and then proves the pointwise criterion by passing to the strict local rings and applying the schemes case there. The descent step together with the strict-local-ring comparison is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 6562-6609.
